target.title: fix(agents): keep bundle LSP tool names provider-safe
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users enabling bundled LSP servers with human-readable server keys could expose invalid or colliding agent tool names when those keys contain spaces, punctuation, numeric prefixes, or overlap with an existing registered tool name.

## Why This Change Was Made

The bundle LSP runtime now keeps the original server key for user-facing labels and execution details while deriving a provider-safe model-facing tool prefix for hover, definition, and references tools. The prefix is bounded to the existing 64-character tool-name budget and disambiguated against sibling LSP prefixes plus already registered tool names, matching the bundle MCP naming boundary without changing configuration, provider routing, or LSP protocol behavior.

## User Impact

Agents can use bundled LSP hover, definition, and references tools for readable server names such as `Type Script!` or numeric keys, and LSP tools are no longer dropped when the sanitized name would collide with a registered tool.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: at current head `4ac65059bdf4ccd46ab78afb3d813aed8de2a004`, bundled LSP tool materialization keeps unsafe and colliding server keys provider-safe and unique while preserving the original server label in execution details.
- Merge refresh: merged `upstream/main` into the PR branch, absorbing the main-side fixes for the unrelated msteams unused-helper and sqlite reliability runner failures that were red on the previous head.
- Focused regression: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/agent-bundle-lsp-runtime.test.ts` passed with 1 file and 14 tests on the prior proof head; the current branch diff against `upstream/main` remains limited to `src/agents/agent-bundle-lsp-runtime.ts` and `src/agents/agent-bundle-lsp-runtime.test.ts`.
- Real behavior proof: GitHub `Real behavior proof` passed on current head `4ac65059bdf4ccd46ab78afb3d813aed8de2a004`: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29244991994/job/86799636496
- Targeted format: `node_modules\.bin\oxfmt.CMD --check --threads=1 src\agents\agent-bundle-lsp-runtime.ts src\agents\agent-bundle-lsp-runtime.test.ts` passed on the prior proof head.
- Diff hygiene: `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` and `git diff --check HEAD~1..HEAD` passed after the merge refresh.
- Duplicate search: no open self PR with the same root cause; `bundle LSP tool name` and `lsp_hover` open PR searches were empty, and `agent-bundle-lsp-runtime` only found adjacent LSP lifecycle/size PRs rather than a tool-name fix.

AI-assisted: yes. I reviewed the bundle LSP runtime path, sibling bundle MCP naming helper, focused regression coverage, current-head merge refresh, and current-head real behavior proof.
